posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
I included AZ because his story is about being dependent on technology to survive, and his gradual acceptance if that fact. 

As a Nemesis, Chokepoint resonates with all of their stories- by integrating with tech, she steadily becomes less human (which parallels AZ's story), she is a dark reflection of unity (she destroys tech to increase herself, whereas Unity brings tech to life). She is a reflection of Bunker as well- a weapon who decided to become more instead of following orders. Bunker has always used tech in service of others, and while he uses the suit to do so, he never becomes it.
